title: Special Executive Programme in Socio-economic and Legal Framework
description: This special executive programme explores the set of rules, regulations, and policies that govern the interactions between individuals, businesses, and government within a given society.
longDescription: This special executive programme provides students with an understanding of the policies and regulations that govern economic and social interactions in a society. It aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills needed to analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of these policies in promoting economic growth and social welfare and reducing inequality. In addition, the course delves into the fundamentals of the socioeconomic and legal frameworks that shape health and social care, focusing on how policies, regulations, and societal factors influence organizational practices. Participants will explore the legal obligations and socioeconomic challenges faced by organizations in the sector. By understanding these concepts, participants will be equipped to develop strategies that ensure compliance, address inequalities, and improve service delivery, enabling their organizations to operate ethically and sustainably. This course is ideal for professionals seeking to strengthen their knowledge of the legal and socioeconomic factors impacting health and social care organizations.
courseDetails: The course on the socio-economic and legal framework is designed to provide students with an in-depth understanding of the policies and regulations that govern economic and social interactions in a society. The course typically covers topics such as taxation, government spending, social welfare programs, labor laws, trade regulations, contract law, property law, and corporate law. modules.title: SOCIO-ECONOMIC AND LEGAL FRAMEWORK
modules.summary: The course aims to develop students' knowledge of the legal and regulatory frameworks that guide business practices and their social and economic obligations. It also aims to equip students with the analytical tools needed to evaluate the effectiveness of these frameworks in promoting economic growth, and social welfare, and reducing inequality.

lessons.title: VIDEO - Course Structure and Assessment Guidelines
Understanding Socioeconomics Factors and their Impact on Business
Understanding the Socio-economic Dynamics and Obligations of a Business
Socio-economic Rights, Economic Crisis, and Legal Doctrine​
Understanding the Governance and Legal Framework of Business Environment
Contractual Dynamics of the Business Environment

outcomes: Understand the socio-economic factors that can impact a business.
Analyze how changes in the socio-economic environment can affect business performance and strategies.
Develop strategies for managing the impact of socioeconomic factors on a business.
Understand the various socio-economic dynamics that can affect a business.
Analyze the social and economic obligations of a business to stakeholders.
Develop strategies for managing socio-economic obligations in a business context.
Understand the legal and regulatory framework that governs businesses in a given environment.
Analyze the impact of governance structures on business practices and performance.
Develop strategies for complying with legal and regulatory requirements in a business context.
Understand the importance of contracts in a business environment and the various types of contracts used in business.
Analyze the key components of a contract and the legal obligations of parties to a contract.
Understand the impact of economic crises on socio-economic rights and the legal framework for protecting these rights.
Analyze the role of legal doctrine in protecting socio-economic rights in a business context.
Develop strategies for promoting socio-economic rights in a business environment.
